note: Site 047 on Red Ridge Road, south of the Red Ridge Road vista: a gravel back-in spur of about 420 ft to a small clearing in the woods, one camping unit. The booking page sells it as a tent and trailer site; DCNR's own campsite map layer calls it tenting-only. Fire ring and picnic table, nothing else. The last 4 miles are forest road (New Lancaster Valley Road, then Red Ridge Road, from Ulsh Gap Road). State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), $10/$15 + $6.50, 40-ft back-in gravel spur graded slight, 14-ft clearance. Imagery rendered (leaf-off): a small tan clearing about 10 m NW of the pin, in mixed conifer woods about 90 m south of Red Ridge Road; pin is on the ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS point. No NHD flowline within 200 m. Note rewritten; pull_through false and reservation fee added.
flags: KEEP-OR-DROP QUESTION: DCNR's Designated Campsites GIS layer (last edited 2022-12-20) has this site as TrailerAccess 'No', Notes 'Tent only', Description 'Tenting-only site. Near vista.', against the booking page's 'Max Vehicle Length: 40' and equipment 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. The booking page is the newer and the one that sells the site, so the entry was left as a keep with both statements in the note.

Forest-wide line on the site page: 'Some Bald Eagle State Forest roads require 4WD and high clearance to travel'. Nothing singles out Red Ridge Road or New Lancaster Valley Road; the DCNR advisories page names neither. Road surface and any weight limits could not be read (Overpass did not answer).
